draft.explanation: The 'Offline Draft' value is stale — it carried over from 2025 via auto-renew and the 2026 draft has not been scheduled yet. Once the commissioner schedules it, Draft Type should read 'Live Standard Draft'.
draft.corroborating_evidence: User plans to switch to autodraft after 10-15 picks. Autodraft only exists in live online drafts, which supports the live reading.
draft.implication: Yahoo's draft-results endpoint populates pick-by-pick in real time during a live draft. Polling it every 5-10s gives exact draft state with zero manual entry. This is the primary data path.

action_required.what: Schedule the 2026 draft in Yahoo so Draft Type flips to Live Standard Draft.
action_required.why_it_matters_beyond_this_app: If the setting is still 'Offline Draft' on draft night, Yahoo hosts no draft room at all and nobody can join. This is a league-wide risk independent of this tool.
action_required.verify_before_draft_day: Confirm Draft Type reads 'Live Standard Draft' and a draft date/time is set.

draft.fallback_plan: Keep the static ranked-candidate plan as a backup. If the draft-results feed is unavailable or the setting never flips, the static plan works with zero dependencies.

history_2025.observation: 8 of 10 teams made the playoffs — only the bottom two missed. A 5-9 team qualified.

Aussie Rules.note: Losing record, 2nd-highest points scored, finished runner-up.

San Antonio.note: Best record AND most points scored — still only 3rd.

Garza's Real Daddy.note: Won the title with the 7th-most points.

history_2025.conclusion: Regular-season record and weekly consistency were nearly irrelevant to the final outcome. The champion scored fewer points than six other teams. This is a variance-dominated league where the only thing that matters is being alive and hot in weeks 15-17.

strategic_implications.detail: Volume rushers and touchdown-dependent players gain substantially. Slot receivers and pass-catching backs whose value is reception-driven lose the most. This reorders the board meaningfully, not marginally.

strategic_implications.finding: Offline draft — no live Yahoo feed
strategic_implications.detail: Yahoo will not expose picks in real time. Draft state has to come from manual entry at the party. This is the single most important constraint on the system design.

67-80% of the field makes the playoffs, and 2025 proved it empirically: a 6-8 team finished runner-up, while the 11-3 team that led the league in scoring finished 3rd, and the champion ranked 7th in points scored. A high-floor, consistency-oriented roster is worth very little here. Draft for ceiling and league-winning upside — the objective is peaking in weeks 15-17, not accumulating regular-season wins.
Shallow starting lineup requirements. Fewer WRs needed than a typical 3-WR league, which softens WR scarcity and makes elite RB and TE relatively more valuable.

Streaming is free and unconstrained all season. Late-round K and DEF are near-worthless draft capital — they can be churned weekly. Do not spend real picks there. Reinforces taking upside swings with bench spots.
Standard, non-premium QB scoring with only one QB slot. QBs should go late relative to their raw point totals. Rushing quarterbacks retain an edge because rushing TDs are worth 6.
Negative scoring is live but mild. Not a reason to downgrade high-volume players.
Draft order is fixed once set. No in-draft trading to model.
